//: Snake Manor's sound effects for the local generator (sfx_local.py, Stable Audio Open). Each cue: `use` says what the sound is for in the game (shown on the audition page); `prompt` describes the sound itself for the model; `seconds` is how long to make it. Prompts describe sounds only, never an artist or an existing work. Recipe: design guide 4.1 (download first, generate second).
negative: music, melody, singing, speech, talking, voices, low quality, distortion, clipping, hiss noise, reverb tail, crowd noise

cues.use: Votes are sealed letters: at the reveal each one is torn open to show the name.
cues.prompt: Foley sound effect: a thick paper envelope sealed with wax is torn open by hand, one crisp tearing rip of heavy paper, close microphone, dry quiet room, high quality recording

cues.use: Right after the tear, the letter unfolds and the accused's name appears.
cues.prompt: Foley sound effect: one sheet of heavy parchment paper is unfolded and smoothed flat, crisp paper rustle, close microphone, dry room, high quality recording

cues.use: A vote is cast: a sealed letter lands on the wooden table (one per vote, quiet).
cues.prompt: Foley sound effect: a thick sealed paper letter dropped onto a wooden table, a single soft paper slap, close microphone, dry room

cues.use: A mission's target was missed: the Snakes earn a Dagger. A blade is drawn.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: a steel dagger drawn slowly from a leather sheath, metallic scrape ending in a clean ring, single action, close microphone

cues.use: A shield is given in secret to the mission's best player.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: a heavy iron shield set down hard on a stone floor, one metallic clang with a short bright ring, single impact

cues.use: The deal: secret roles are dealt to everyone at the start.
cues.prompt: Foley sound effect: a deck of playing cards shuffled once and then dealt quickly onto a felt table, several crisp card flicks, close microphone

cues.use: The unmasking: a mask is pulled off a player to show who they really were.
cues.prompt: Foley sound effect: a velvet cloth mask pulled off quickly, one soft fabric whoosh, single movement, close microphone, dry

cues.use: The last table: each player's End-or-banish vote is a knock at the door.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: two heavy knocks on an old thick wooden castle door, deep and resonant, stone hallway, nothing else

cues.use: Breakfast: the staff gasp when they find an empty chair (someone vanished).
cues.prompt: Sound effect: a small group of people gasp together in shock, one short sharp intake of breath, indoor hall, no words

cues.use: Good news: a mission hits its target, or the Guests win.
cues.prompt: A short triumphant medieval brass fanfare, two natural trumpets, bright and regal, three rising phrases ending on a held major chord, recorded in a stone hall

cues.use: Bad news, played for laughs: a mission misses its target.
cues.prompt: A short medieval trumpet fanfare that goes badly out of tune and fizzles out with a sad wobble, comedic and deflating, one trumpet, stone hall

cues.use: Breakfast: everyone made it through the night.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: a small brass hand bell rung twice, bright clear tone, short natural decay, quiet room

cues.use: Breakfast: morning over the manor, before we see who's missing.
cues.prompt: Ambience: early morning songbirds chirping in a quiet countryside garden, gentle and peaceful, no traffic, no people

cues.use: The last ten seconds of a vote or the night: one tick per second.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: one single loud tick of an old wooden grandfather clock, dry and close, one tick only

cues.use: A banished player turns out to be a Snake: a serpent's hiss as the word lands.
cues.prompt: Sound effect: a long menacing snake hiss, close to the microphone, swelling then fading out, a real reptile, no other sound

cues.use: A banished player turns out to be an innocent Guest: one sad lute note as the candles go out.
cues.prompt: A single sad plucked lute note followed by a second lower note, melancholy and quiet, solo medieval lute, slow decay, no other instruments
